CA.name: American spikenard
CA.citation: Native Plants of North America database; native range confirmed from New Brunswick to Manitoba. Species-specific name, consistently distinguished in sources from true spikenard (Nardostachys jatamansi), the unrelated Himalayan plant of biblical/ancient trade fame

GB.name: American spikenard
GB.citation: Royal Horticultural Society (RHS) plant record, listed as "Aralia racemosa | American spikenard (American nard)"
